name: @listen-fire/fake-channels
description: Stand-in implementations of the third-party services (Slack, Attio, Affinity, Airtable, Sheets, email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Gmail, Drive, Dropbox, an OAuth2 provider, the model vendors and more) with a control door to seed and inspect them. The dev loop, the demo image, lf's test harness and the examples all run these instead of real accounts. Start it with `fake-channels` (port from FAKE_CHANNELS_PORT, 0 for a free one).
